_comment: Moves added after the native 354. Numbers, type, category, target and flags come from PokeAPI; this file only chooses the engine effect, the reused animation, the 12-character name and the descriptions. A move is listed only when its effect is implemented.

AQUA_TAIL.name: AQUA TAIL
AQUA_TAIL.en: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave.
AQUA_TAIL.pt: Ataca balançando a cauda como uma onda violenta.

DAZZLING_GLEAM.name: DAZZLE GLEAM
DAZZLING_GLEAM.en: The user damages foes by emitting a powerful flash.
DAZZLING_GLEAM.pt: Fere os oponentes com um clarão poderoso.

DRAGON_PULSE.name: DRAGON PULSE
DRAGON_PULSE.en: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
DRAGON_PULSE.pt: Ataca com uma onda de choque disparada pela boca aberta.

FAIRY_WIND.name: FAIRY WIND
FAIRY_WIND.en: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the foe with it.
FAIRY_WIND.pt: Levanta um vento feérico e atinge o alvo.

HIGH_HORSEPOWER.name: HIGH H.POWER
HIGH_HORSEPOWER.en: The foe is fiercely attacked using the user's entire body.
HIGH_HORSEPOWER.pt: Ataca ferozmente usando o corpo inteiro.

LEAFAGE.name: LEAFAGE
LEAFAGE.en: The user attacks by pelting the foe with leaves.

ORIGIN_PULSE.name: ORIGIN PULSE
ORIGIN_PULSE.en: Opposing POKéMON are attacked with countless beams of glowing blue light.
ORIGIN_PULSE.pt: Atinge os oponentes com incontáveis raios de luz azul.

POWER_GEM.name: POWER GEM
POWER_GEM.en: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if made of gemstones.
POWER_GEM.pt: Ataca com um raio de luz que brilha como pedras preciosas.

POWER_WHIP.name: POWER WHIP
POWER_WHIP.en: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.
POWER_WHIP.pt: Gira vinhas ou tentáculos para chicotear o alvo com força.

PRECIPICE_BLADES.name: PRECIP.BLADE
PRECIPICE_BLADES.en: The user attacks foes by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.
PRECIPICE_BLADES.pt: Ataca os oponentes com lâminas de pedra nascidas da terra.

SEED_BOMB.name: SEED BOMB
SEED_BOMB.en: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the foe.
SEED_BOMB.pt: Arremessa uma rajada de sementes de casca dura no alvo.

X_SCISSOR.name: X-SCISSOR
X_SCISSOR.en: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws.
X_SCISSOR.pt: Corta o alvo cruzando foices ou garras.

BOOMBURST.name: BOOMBURST
BOOMBURST.en: The user attacks everything around it with a terrible, explosive sound.
BOOMBURST.pt: Atinge todos ao redor com um som explosivo e destrutivo.

PETAL_BLIZZARD.name: PETAL BLIZZ.
PETAL_BLIZZARD.en: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.
PETAL_BLIZZARD.pt: Levanta uma nevasca de pétalas e atinge todos ao redor.

HYPER_DRILL.name: HYPER DRILL
HYPER_DRILL.en: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed. It can bypass PROTECT and DETECT.
HYPER_DRILL.pt: Gira a parte pontuda do corpo em alta velocidade. Ignora PROTECT e DETECT.

AQUA_JET.name: AQUA JET
AQUA_JET.en: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It always strikes first.
AQUA_JET.pt: Avança tão rápido que quase some de vista. Sempre ataca primeiro.

BULLET_PUNCH.name: BULLET PUNCH
BULLET_PUNCH.en: The user strikes with tough punches as fast as bullets. It always strikes first.
BULLET_PUNCH.pt: Soca rápido como balas. Sempre ataca primeiro.

ICE_SHARD.name: ICE SHARD
ICE_SHARD.en: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. It always strikes first.
ICE_SHARD.pt: Congela pedaços de gelo e os arremessa. Sempre ataca primeiro.

SHADOW_SNEAK.name: SHADOW SNEAK
SHADOW_SNEAK.en: The user extends its shadow and attacks from behind. It always strikes first.
SHADOW_SNEAK.pt: Estende a sombra e ataca pelas costas. Sempre ataca primeiro.

VACUUM_WAVE.name: VACUUM WAVE
VACUUM_WAVE.en: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum. It always strikes first.
VACUUM_WAVE.pt: Gira os punhos e lança uma onda de vácuo. Sempre ataca primeiro.

AIR_SLASH.name: AIR SLASH
AIR_SLASH.en: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may make the foe flinch.
AIR_SLASH.pt: Ataca com uma lâmina de ar. Pode fazer o alvo recuar.

DARK_PULSE.name: DARK PULSE
DARK_PULSE.en: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may make the foe flinch.
DARK_PULSE.pt: Libera uma aura sombria e terrível. Pode fazer o alvo recuar.

DRAGON_RUSH.name: DRAGON RUSH
DRAGON_RUSH.en: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may make the foe flinch.
DRAGON_RUSH.pt: Investe com uma ameaça avassaladora. Pode fazer o alvo recuar.

ICICLE_CRASH.name: ICICLE CRASH
ICICLE_CRASH.en: The user drops large icicles onto the foe. It may make the foe flinch.
ICICLE_CRASH.pt: Derruba grandes pingentes de gelo no alvo. Pode fazê-lo recuar.

IRON_HEAD.name: IRON HEAD
IRON_HEAD.en: The user slams the foe with its steel-hard head. It may make the foe flinch.
IRON_HEAD.pt: Golpeia com a cabeça dura como aço. Pode fazer o alvo recuar.

ZEN_HEADBUTT.name: ZEN HEADBUTT
ZEN_HEADBUTT.en: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks. It may make the foe flinch.
ZEN_HEADBUTT.pt: Concentra a força de vontade na cabeça e ataca. Pode fazer o alvo recuar.

BUG_BUZZ.name: BUG BUZZ
BUG_BUZZ.en: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. It may lower the foe's SP. DEF.
BUG_BUZZ.pt: Vibra e gera uma onda sonora. Pode reduzir a DEF. ESP. do alvo.

EARTH_POWER.name: EARTH POWER
EARTH_POWER.en: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may lower the foe's SP. DEF.
EARTH_POWER.pt: Faz o chão sob o alvo explodir. Pode reduzir a DEF. ESP. do alvo.

ENERGY_BALL.name: ENERGY BALL
ENERGY_BALL.en: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may lower the foe's SP. DEF.
ENERGY_BALL.pt: Lança a energia da natureza. Pode reduzir a DEF. ESP. do alvo.

FLASH_CANNON.name: FLASH CANNON
FLASH_CANNON.en: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may lower the foe's SP. DEF.
FLASH_CANNON.pt: Reúne toda a energia luminosa e a libera. Pode reduzir a DEF. ESP. do alvo.

FOCUS_BLAST.name: FOCUS BLAST
FOCUS_BLAST.en: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may lower the foe's SP. DEF.
FOCUS_BLAST.pt: Concentra a mente e libera seu poder. Pode reduzir a DEF. ESP. do alvo.

DRILL_RUN.name: DRILL RUN
DRILL_RUN.en: The user crashes into the foe while rotating like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.
DRILL_RUN.pt: Gira como uma broca e colide com o alvo. Acerto crítico mais fácil.

NIGHT_SLASH.name: NIGHT SLASH
NIGHT_SLASH.en: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.
NIGHT_SLASH.pt: Corta o alvo na primeira oportunidade. Acerto crítico mais fácil.

PSYCHO_CUT.name: PSYCHO CUT
PSYCHO_CUT.en: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.
PSYCHO_CUT.pt: Rasga o alvo com lâminas psíquicas. Acerto crítico mais fácil.

SHADOW_CLAW.name: SHADOW CLAW
SHADOW_CLAW.en: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
SHADOW_CLAW.pt: Corta com uma garra feita de sombras. Acerto crítico mais fácil.

STONE_EDGE.name: STONE EDGE
STONE_EDGE.en: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. Critical hits land more easily.
STONE_EDGE.pt: Perfura o alvo com pedras afiadas vindas de baixo. Acerto crítico mais fácil.

INFERNO.name: INFERNO
INFERNO.en: The user attacks by engulfing the foe in an intense fire. It leaves the foe with a burn.
INFERNO.pt: Envolve o alvo em fogo intenso e causa queimadura.

LAVA_PLUME.name: LAVA PLUME
LAVA_PLUME.en: The user torches everything around it in flames. It may leave targets with a burn.
LAVA_PLUME.pt: Incendeia todos ao redor. Pode causar queimadura.

SCALD.name: SCALD
SCALD.en: The user shoots boiling hot water at the foe. It may leave the foe with a burn.
SCALD.pt: Dispara água fervente no alvo. Pode causar queimadura.

SCORCHING_SANDS.name: SCORCH SANDS
SCORCHING_SANDS.en: The user throws scorching sand at the foe. It may leave the foe with a burn.
SCORCHING_SANDS.pt: Arremessa areia escaldante no alvo. Pode causar queimadura.

MOONBLAST.name: MOONBLAST
MOONBLAST.en: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks. It may lower the foe's SP. ATK.
MOONBLAST.pt: Ataca com o poder da lua. Pode reduzir o ATQ. ESP. do alvo.

MYSTICAL_FIRE.name: MYSTIC FIRE
MYSTICAL_FIRE.en: The user breathes a special, hot fire. It also lowers the foe's SP. ATK.
MYSTICAL_FIRE.pt: Sopra um fogo místico. Também reduz o ATQ. ESP. do alvo.

SNARL.name: SNARL
SNARL.en: The user yells as if it is ranting about something. It lowers the foes' SP. ATK.
SNARL.pt: Grita como se estivesse esbravejando. Reduz o ATQ. ESP. dos oponentes.

STRUGGLE_BUG.name: STRUGGLE BUG
STRUGGLE_BUG.en: While resisting, the user attacks the foes. It lowers their SP. ATK.
STRUGGLE_BUG.pt: Ataca os oponentes enquanto resiste. Reduz o ATQ. ESP. deles.

SKITTER_SMACK.name: SKITTERSMACK
SKITTER_SMACK.en: The user skitters behind the foe to attack. It lowers the foe's SP. ATK.
SKITTER_SMACK.pt: Corre por trás do alvo e ataca. Reduz o ATQ. ESP. do alvo.

GUNK_SHOT.name: GUNK SHOT
GUNK_SHOT.en: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe. It may also poison the foe.
GUNK_SHOT.pt: Dispara lixo imundo no alvo. Pode envenená-lo.

POISON_JAB.name: POISON JAB
POISON_JAB.en: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.
POISON_JAB.pt: Perfura com um tentáculo ou braço venenoso. Pode envenenar o alvo.

SLUDGE_WAVE.name: SLUDGE WAVE
SLUDGE_WAVE.en: The user strikes everything around it with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison them.
SLUDGE_WAVE.pt: Atinge todos ao redor com uma onda de lodo. Pode envenená-los.

AURA_SPHERE.name: AURA SPHERE
AURA_SPHERE.en: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This attack never misses.
AURA_SPHERE.pt: Libera uma esfera de aura do fundo do corpo. Nunca erra.

SMART_STRIKE.name: SMART STRIKE
SMART_STRIKE.en: The user stabs the foe with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
SMART_STRIKE.pt: Perfura o alvo com um chifre afiado. Nunca erra.

DISARMING_VOICE.name: DISARM VOICE
DISARMING_VOICE.en: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to foes. This attack never misses.
DISARMING_VOICE.pt: Solta um grito encantador que fere os oponentes. Nunca erra.

BRAVE_BIRD.name: BRAVE BIRD
BRAVE_BIRD.en: The user tucks in its wings and charges from low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.
BRAVE_BIRD.pt: Recolhe as asas e investe em voo baixo. O usuário também sofre muito dano.

WOOD_HAMMER.name: WOOD HAMMER
WOOD_HAMMER.en: The user slams its rugged body into the foe. The user also takes serious damage.
WOOD_HAMMER.pt: Golpeia com o corpo robusto. O usuário também sofre muito dano.

WAVE_CRASH.name: WAVE CRASH
WAVE_CRASH.en: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the foe. The user also takes serious damage.
WAVE_CRASH.pt: Envolve-se em água e colide com o alvo. O usuário também sofre muito dano.

DISCHARGE.name: DISCHARGE
DISCHARGE.en: A flare of electricity strikes everything around the user. It may cause paralysis.
DISCHARGE.pt: Libera uma descarga elétrica em todos ao redor. Pode paralisar.

FORCE_PALM.name: FORCE PALM
FORCE_PALM.en: The foe is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.
FORCE_PALM.pt: Ataca com uma onda de choque. Pode paralisar o alvo.

NUZZLE.name: NUZZLE
NUZZLE.en: The user nuzzles its electrified cheeks against the foe. This leaves the foe paralyzed.
NUZZLE.pt: Esfrega as bochechas elétricas no alvo e o paralisa.

DOUBLE_HIT.name: DOUBLE HIT
DOUBLE_HIT.en: The user slams the foe with a long tail, vines, or a tentacle. The foe is hit twice in a row.
DOUBLE_HIT.pt: Golpeia com cauda, vinhas ou tentáculo. Acerta duas vezes seguidas.

DUAL_WINGBEAT.name: DUALWINGBEAT
DUAL_WINGBEAT.en: The user slams the foe with its wings. The foe is hit twice in a row.
DUAL_WINGBEAT.pt: Golpeia o alvo com as asas. Acerta duas vezes seguidas.

TWIN_BEAM.name: TWIN BEAM
TWIN_BEAM.en: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes. The foe is hit twice in a row.
TWIN_BEAM.pt: Dispara raios místicos dos olhos. Acerta duas vezes seguidas.

DRACO_METEOR.name: DRACO METEOR
DRACO_METEOR.en: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The recoil harshly lowers the user's SP. ATK.
DRACO_METEOR.pt: Invoca cometas do céu. O impacto reduz muito o ATQ. ESP. do usuário.

LEAF_STORM.name: LEAF STORM
LEAF_STORM.en: The user whips up a storm of leaves. The recoil harshly lowers the user's SP. ATK.
LEAF_STORM.pt: Cria uma tempestade de folhas. O esforço reduz muito o ATQ. ESP. do usuário.

ELECTROWEB.name: ELECTROWEB
ELECTROWEB.en: The user captures the foes in an electric net. It lowers their SPEED.
ELECTROWEB.pt: Prende os oponentes numa rede elétrica. Reduz a VELOCIDADE deles.

LOW_SWEEP.name: LOW SWEEP
LOW_SWEEP.en: The user swiftly attacks the foe's legs. It lowers the foe's SPEED.
LOW_SWEEP.pt: Ataca rapidamente as pernas do alvo. Reduz a VELOCIDADE dele.

BULLDOZE.name: BULLDOZE
BULLDOZE.en: The user strikes everything around it by stomping on the ground. It lowers their SPEED.
BULLDOZE.pt: Pisa forte no chão e atinge todos ao redor. Reduz a VELOCIDADE deles.

POUNCE.name: POUNCE
POUNCE.en: The user springs at the foe. It lowers the foe's SPEED.
POUNCE.pt: Salta sobre o alvo. Reduz a VELOCIDADE dele.

LIQUIDATION.name: LIQUIDATION
LIQUIDATION.en: The user slams into the foe using a full-force blast of water. It may lower the foe's DEFENSE.
LIQUIDATION.pt: Colide com um jato de água a toda força. Pode reduzir a DEFESA do alvo.

RAZOR_SHELL.name: RAZOR SHELL
RAZOR_SHELL.en: The user cuts the foe with sharp shells. It may lower the foe's DEFENSE.
RAZOR_SHELL.pt: Corta o alvo com conchas afiadas. Pode reduzir a DEFESA dele.

PLAY_ROUGH.name: PLAY ROUGH
PLAY_ROUGH.en: The user plays rough with the foe and attacks it. It may lower the foe's ATTACK.
PLAY_ROUGH.pt: Brinca de forma bruta com o alvo. Pode reduzir o ATAQUE dele.

BREAKING_SWIPE.name: BREAK SWIPE
BREAKING_SWIPE.en: The user swings its tough tail wildly at the foes. It lowers their ATTACK.
BREAKING_SWIPE.pt: Agita a cauda resistente contra os oponentes. Reduz o ATAQUE deles.

LUNGE.name: LUNGE
LUNGE.en: The user makes a lunge at the foe. It lowers the foe's ATTACK.
LUNGE.pt: Avança com tudo sobre o alvo. Reduz o ATAQUE dele.

CHILLING_WATER.name: CHILL WATER
CHILLING_WATER.en: The user showers the foe with icy cold water. It lowers the foe's ATTACK.
CHILLING_WATER.pt: Molha o alvo com água gelada. Reduz o ATAQUE dele.

DRAIN_PUNCH.name: DRAIN PUNCH
DRAIN_PUNCH.en: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the foe.
DRAIN_PUNCH.pt: Soco que drena energia. Recupera metade do dano causado.

WILD_CHARGE.name: WILD CHARGE
WILD_CHARGE.en: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into the foe. It hurts the user a little.
WILD_CHARGE.pt: Envolve-se em eletricidade e colide com o alvo. Também fere um pouco o usuário.

GIGA_IMPACT.name: GIGA IMPACT
GIGA_IMPACT.en: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.
GIGA_IMPACT.pt: Investe com toda a sua força. O usuário precisa descansar no turno seguinte.

ROCK_CLIMB.name: ROCK CLIMB
ROCK_CLIMB.en: The user attacks the foe by smashing into it with incredible force. It may confuse the foe.
ROCK_CLIMB.pt: Colide com o alvo com força incrível. Pode confundi-lo.

HURRICANE.name: HURRICANE
HURRICANE.en: The user wraps the foe in a fierce wind. It may confuse the foe. It never misses in rain.
HURRICANE.pt: Envolve o alvo num vento feroz. Pode confundi-lo. Nunca erra na chuva.

NASTY_PLOT.name: NASTY PLOT
NASTY_PLOT.en: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's SP. ATK.
NASTY_PLOT.pt: Estimula a mente com maus pensamentos. Aumenta muito o ATQ. ESP.

ROCK_POLISH.name: ROCK POLISH
ROCK_POLISH.en: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It sharply raises the user's SPEED.
ROCK_POLISH.pt: Lustra o corpo para reduzir o atrito. Aumenta muito a VELOCIDADE.

BABY_DOLL_EYES.name: BABYDOLLEYES
BABY_DOLL_EYES.en: The user stares at the foe with its baby-doll eyes, lowering its ATTACK. It always goes first.
BABY_DOLL_EYES.pt: Encara o alvo com olhos de boneca e reduz o ATAQUE dele. Sempre age primeiro.

PLAY_NICE.name: PLAY NICE
PLAY_NICE.en: The user befriends the foe, sapping its will to fight. It lowers the foe's ATTACK.
PLAY_NICE.pt: Faz amizade com o alvo, que perde a vontade de lutar. Reduz o ATAQUE dele.

EERIE_IMPULSE.name: EERIEIMPULSE
EERIE_IMPULSE.en: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. It harshly lowers the foe's SP. ATK.
EERIE_IMPULSE.pt: Gera um impulso estranho. Reduz muito o ATQ. ESP. do alvo.

CROSS_POISON.name: CROSS POISON
CROSS_POISON.en: A slashing attack that may poison the foe. Critical hits land more easily.
CROSS_POISON.pt: Corte que pode envenenar o alvo. Acerto crítico mais fácil.

RAGING_BULL.name: RAGING BULL
RAGING_BULL.en: The user tackles like a raging bull. It also breaks LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.
RAGING_BULL.pt: Investe como um touro furioso. Também quebra LIGHT SCREEN e REFLECT.

PSYCHIC_FANGS.name: PSYCHICFANGS
PSYCHIC_FANGS.en: The user bites with psychic power. It also breaks LIGHT SCREEN and REFLECT.
PSYCHIC_FANGS.pt: Morde com poderes psíquicos. Também quebra LIGHT SCREEN e REFLECT.

ICE_SPINNER.name: ICE SPINNER
ICE_SPINNER.en: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls into the foe. It also destroys the terrain.
ICE_SPINNER.pt: Cobre os pés com gelo fino e gira contra o alvo. Também destrói o terreno.

SOLAR_BLADE.name: SOLAR BLADE
SOLAR_BLADE.en: The user gathers light, then slashes with a blade of light next turn. No charge in sunlight.
SOLAR_BLADE.pt: Absorve luz e corta com uma lâmina luminosa no turno seguinte. Sem espera sob sol.

GRASS_KNOT.name: GRASS KNOT
GRASS_KNOT.en: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.
GRASS_KNOT.pt: Prende o alvo com grama e o derruba. Quanto mais pesado, maior o dano.

AVALANCHE.name: AVALANCHE
AVALANCHE.en: An attack that inflicts double damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.
AVALANCHE.pt: Causa dano dobrado se o usuário foi ferido pelo alvo no mesmo turno.

CLOSE_COMBAT.name: CLOSE COMBAT
CLOSE_COMBAT.en: The user fights up close without guarding itself. It lowers the user's DEFENSE and SP. DEF.
CLOSE_COMBAT.pt: Luta de perto sem se proteger. Reduz a DEFESA e a DEF. ESP. do usuário.

DRAGON_ASCENT.name: DRAGONASCENT
DRAGON_ASCENT.en: The user soars upward and drops at high speed. It lowers the user's DEFENSE and SP. DEF.
DRAGON_ASCENT.pt: Sobe aos céus e mergulha em alta velocidade. Reduz a DEFESA e a DEF. ESP. do usuário.

HEADLONG_RUSH.name: HEADLONGRUSH
HEADLONG_RUSH.en: The user smashes into the foe in a full-body tackle. It lowers the user's DEFENSE and SP. DEF.
HEADLONG_RUSH.pt: Investe com o corpo inteiro. Reduz a DEFESA e a DEF. ESP. do usuário.

HAMMER_ARM.name: HAMMER ARM
HAMMER_ARM.en: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user's SPEED.
HAMMER_ARM.pt: Golpeia com o punho pesado. Reduz a VELOCIDADE do usuário.

FLAME_CHARGE.name: FLAME CHARGE
FLAME_CHARGE.en: The user cloaks itself in flame and attacks. It raises the user's SPEED.
FLAME_CHARGE.pt: Envolve-se em chamas e ataca. Aumenta a VELOCIDADE do usuário.

TRAILBLAZE.name: TRAILBLAZE
TRAILBLAZE.en: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. It raises the user's SPEED.
TRAILBLAZE.pt: Ataca de surpresa como se saltasse do mato alto. Aumenta a VELOCIDADE do usuário.

CHARGE_BEAM.name: CHARGE BEAM
CHARGE_BEAM.en: The user attacks with an electric charge. It may raise the user's SP. ATK.
CHARGE_BEAM.pt: Ataca com uma carga elétrica. Pode aumentar o ATQ. ESP. do usuário.

ACID_SPRAY.name: ACID SPRAY
ACID_SPRAY.en: The user spits fluid that melts the foe. It harshly lowers the foe's SP. DEF.
ACID_SPRAY.pt: Cospe um fluido corrosivo. Reduz muito a DEF. ESP. do alvo.

HEAD_SMASH.name: HEAD SMASH
HEAD_SMASH.en: The user attacks with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.
HEAD_SMASH.pt: Desfere uma cabeçada com força total. O usuário também sofre dano terrível.

FLARE_BLITZ.name: FLARE BLITZ
FLARE_BLITZ.en: The user charges cloaked in fire. It may burn the foe. The user also takes serious damage.
FLARE_BLITZ.pt: Envolve-se em fogo e investe. Pode queimar o alvo. O usuário sofre muito dano.

FIRE_FANG.name: FIRE FANG
FIRE_FANG.en: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may burn the foe or make it flinch.
FIRE_FANG.pt: Morde com presas em chamas. Pode queimar o alvo ou fazê-lo recuar.

ICE_FANG.name: ICE FANG
ICE_FANG.en: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may freeze the foe or make it flinch.
ICE_FANG.pt: Morde com presas geladas. Pode congelar o alvo ou fazê-lo recuar.

THUNDER_FANG.name: THUNDER FANG
THUNDER_FANG.en: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may paralyze the foe or make it flinch.
THUNDER_FANG.pt: Morde com presas elétricas. Pode paralisar o alvo ou fazê-lo recuar.

FROST_BREATH.name: FROST BREATH
FROST_BREATH.en: The user blows its cold breath on the foe. This attack always results in a critical hit.
FROST_BREATH.pt: Sopra um hálito gelado no alvo. Sempre causa acerto crítico.

STORM_THROW.name: STORM THROW
STORM_THROW.en: The user strikes the foe with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
STORM_THROW.pt: Arremessa o alvo com um golpe feroz. Sempre causa acerto crítico.

DRAINING_KISS.name: DRAININGKISS
DRAINING_KISS.en: The user steals the foe's HP with a kiss, restoring HP equal to most of the damage dealt.
DRAINING_KISS.pt: Rouba HP do alvo com um beijo. Recupera a maior parte do dano causado.

SWITCHEROO.name: SWITCHEROO
SWITCHEROO.en: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.
SWITCHEROO.pt: Troca de item com o alvo mais rápido do que o olho pode ver.

COIL.name: COIL
COIL.en: The user coils up and concentrates. It raises its ATTACK, DEFENSE, and accuracy.
COIL.pt: Enrola-se e se concentra. Aumenta ATAQUE, DEFESA e precisão.

HONE_CLAWS.name: HONE CLAWS
HONE_CLAWS.en: The user sharpens its claws to boost its ATTACK and accuracy.
HONE_CLAWS.pt: Afia as garras e aumenta o ATAQUE e a precisão.

WORK_UP.name: WORK UP
WORK_UP.en: The user is roused, and its ATTACK and SP. ATK increase.
WORK_UP.pt: Fica estimulado e aumenta o ATAQUE e o ATQ. ESP.

QUIVER_DANCE.name: QUIVER DANCE
QUIVER_DANCE.en: The user performs a beautiful, mystic dance. It raises the user's SP. ATK, SP. DEF, and SPEED.
QUIVER_DANCE.pt: Faz uma dança mística. Aumenta ATQ. ESP., DEF. ESP. e VELOCIDADE.

NOBLE_ROAR.name: NOBLE ROAR
NOBLE_ROAR.en: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the foe. It lowers the foe's ATTACK and SP. ATK.
NOBLE_ROAR.pt: Solta um rugido nobre. Reduz o ATAQUE e o ATQ. ESP. do alvo.

TEARFUL_LOOK.name: TEARFUL LOOK
TEARFUL_LOOK.en: The user gets teary eyed to sap the foe's will to fight. It lowers its ATTACK and SP. ATK.
TEARFUL_LOOK.pt: Fica com os olhos marejados. Reduz o ATAQUE e o ATQ. ESP. do alvo.

COTTON_GUARD.name: COTTON GUARD
COTTON_GUARD.en: The user wraps itself in soft cotton. It drastically raises the user's DEFENSE.
COTTON_GUARD.pt: Envolve-se em algodão macio. Aumenta drasticamente a DEFESA.

SHELL_SMASH.name: SHELL SMASH
SHELL_SMASH.en: The user breaks its shell, lowering its defenses but sharply raising ATTACK, SP. ATK and SPEED.
SHELL_SMASH.pt: Quebra a carapaça. Reduz as defesas, mas aumenta muito ATAQUE, ATQ. ESP. e VELOCIDADE.

TOXIC_THREAD.name: TOXIC THREAD
TOXIC_THREAD.en: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the foe and lower its SPEED.
TOXIC_THREAD.pt: Lança fios venenosos que envenenam o alvo e reduzem sua VELOCIDADE.

HEX.name: HEX
HEX.en: This relentless attack does massive damage to a foe affected by status conditions.
HEX.pt: Ataque implacável que causa dano enorme a um alvo com problema de status.

VENOSHOCK.name: VENOSHOCK
VENOSHOCK.en: The user drenches the foe in a poisonous liquid. Its power doubles if the foe is poisoned.
VENOSHOCK.pt: Encharca o alvo com um líquido venenoso. O poder dobra se o alvo estiver envenenado.

BRINE.name: BRINE
BRINE.en: If the foe's HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.
BRINE.pt: Se o HP do alvo estiver na metade ou menos, o ataque tem o dobro de poder.

ACROBATICS.name: ACROBATICS
ACROBATICS.en: The user nimbly strikes the foe. Its power doubles if the user is not holding an item.
ACROBATICS.pt: Golpeia o alvo com agilidade. O poder dobra se o usuário não segurar item.

ASSURANCE.name: ASSURANCE
ASSURANCE.en: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.
ASSURANCE.pt: Se o alvo já sofreu dano no mesmo turno, o poder deste ataque dobra.

PAYBACK.name: PAYBACK
PAYBACK.en: The user stores power, then attacks. Its power doubles if the user moves after the foe.
PAYBACK.pt: Acumula força e ataca. O poder dobra se o usuário agir depois do alvo.

ELECTRO_BALL.name: ELECTRO BALL
ELECTRO_BALL.en: The user hurls an electric orb. The faster the user is than the foe, the greater the power.
ELECTRO_BALL.pt: Arremessa uma esfera elétrica. Quanto mais rápido que o alvo, maior o poder.

GYRO_BALL.name: GYRO BALL
GYRO_BALL.en: The user tackles with a fast spin. The slower the user is than the foe, the greater the power.
GYRO_BALL.pt: Investe girando em alta velocidade. Quanto mais lento que o alvo, maior o poder.

HEAVY_SLAM.name: HEAVY SLAM
HEAVY_SLAM.en: The user slams its heavy body into the foe. The heavier the user, the greater the power.
HEAVY_SLAM.pt: Esmaga o alvo com o corpo pesado. Quanto mais pesado que o alvo, maior o poder.

HEAT_CRASH.name: HEAT CRASH
HEAT_CRASH.en: The user slams its fiery body into the foe. The heavier the user, the greater the power.
HEAT_CRASH.pt: Esmaga o alvo com o corpo em chamas. Quanto mais pesado que o alvo, maior o poder.

HARD_PRESS.name: HARD PRESS
HARD_PRESS.en: The foe is crushed with an arm or a claw. The more HP the foe has left, the greater the power.
HARD_PRESS.pt: Esmaga o alvo com braço ou garra. Quanto mais HP o alvo tiver, maior o poder.

STORED_POWER.name: STORED POWER
STORED_POWER.en: The user attacks with stored power. The more its stats are raised, the greater the power.
STORED_POWER.pt: Ataca com poder acumulado. Quanto mais atributos elevados, maior o poder.

POWER_TRIP.name: POWER TRIP
POWER_TRIP.en: The user boasts its strength and attacks. The more its stats are raised, the greater the power.
POWER_TRIP.pt: Exibe sua força e ataca. Quanto mais atributos elevados, maior o poder.

FOUL_PLAY.name: FOUL PLAY
FOUL_PLAY.en: The user turns the foe's power against it. It uses the foe's ATTACK to calculate damage.
FOUL_PLAY.pt: Usa a força do alvo contra ele. O dano é calculado com o ATAQUE do alvo.

BODY_PRESS.name: BODY PRESS
BODY_PRESS.en: The user slams its body into the foe. It uses the user's DEFENSE instead of ATTACK.
BODY_PRESS.pt: Golpeia com o corpo. Usa a DEFESA do usuário no lugar do ATAQUE.

PSYSHOCK.name: PSYSHOCK
PSYSHOCK.en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave. It damages the foe's DEFENSE, not its SP. DEF.
PSYSHOCK.pt: Materializa uma onda psíquica. O dano usa a DEFESA do alvo, não a DEF. ESP.

PSYSTRIKE.name: PSYSTRIKE
PSYSTRIKE.en: The user materializes a strong psychic wave. It damages the foe's DEFENSE, not its SP. DEF.
PSYSTRIKE.pt: Materializa uma forte onda psíquica. O dano usa a DEFESA do alvo, não a DEF. ESP.

FREEZE_DRY.name: FREEZE-DRY
FREEZE_DRY.en: The user rapidly cools the foe. It may freeze it. It is super effective on WATER types.
FREEZE_DRY.pt: Resfria o alvo rapidamente. Pode congelá-lo. É super eficaz contra o tipo WATER.

U_TURN.name: U-TURN
U_TURN.en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party POKéMON.
U_TURN.pt: Depois de atacar, o usuário volta e troca de lugar com um POKéMON da equipe.

VOLT_SWITCH.name: VOLT SWITCH
VOLT_SWITCH.en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party POKéMON.
VOLT_SWITCH.pt: Depois de atacar, o usuário volta e troca de lugar com um POKéMON da equipe.

FLIP_TURN.name: FLIP TURN
FLIP_TURN.en: After attacking, the user rushes back at great speed to switch places with a party POKéMON.
FLIP_TURN.pt: Depois de atacar, volta em alta velocidade e troca com um POKéMON da equipe.

DRAGON_TAIL.name: DRAGON TAIL
DRAGON_TAIL.en: The foe is knocked away, and a different POKéMON is dragged out. In the wild, the battle ends.
DRAGON_TAIL.pt: Arremessa o alvo e força outro POKéMON a entrar. Na natureza, a batalha termina.

FEINT.name: FEINT
FEINT.en: An attack that hits a foe using PROTECT or DETECT. It also lifts the effects of those moves.
FEINT.pt: Atinge um alvo protegido por PROTECT ou DETECT e desfaz esses efeitos.

SUCKER_PUNCH.name: SUCKER PUNCH
SUCKER_PUNCH.en: The user attacks first. It only works if the foe is readying an attack.
SUCKER_PUNCH.pt: Ataca primeiro. Só funciona se o alvo estiver preparando um ataque.

UPPER_HAND.name: UPPER HAND
UPPER_HAND.en: The user reacts first and makes the foe flinch. Works only against a priority move.
UPPER_HAND.pt: Reage primeiro e faz o alvo recuar. Só funciona contra golpes de prioridade.

CLEAR_SMOG.name: CLEAR SMOG
CLEAR_SMOG.en: The user throws a clump of special mud. All of the foe's stat changes are reset.
CLEAR_SMOG.pt: Arremessa uma lama especial. Todas as mudanças de atributo do alvo são desfeitas.

LIFE_DEW.name: LIFE DEW
LIFE_DEW.en: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally.
LIFE_DEW.pt: Espalha uma água misteriosa e recupera o HP do usuário e do aliado.

HEAL_PULSE.name: HEAL PULSE
HEAL_PULSE.en: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.
HEAL_PULSE.pt: Emite um pulso de cura que recupera até metade do HP máximo do alvo.

RAGE_POWDER.name: RAGE POWDER
RAGE_POWDER.en: The user scatters irritating powder to draw attention. Foes aim only at the user.
RAGE_POWDER.pt: Espalha um pó irritante para chamar atenção. Os oponentes miram só no usuário.

POLLEN_PUFF.name: POLLEN PUFF
POLLEN_PUFF.en: The user attacks with an exploding pollen puff. If the target is an ally, it heals it.
POLLEN_PUFF.pt: Ataca com uma bola de pólen explosiva. Se o alvo for aliado, ele é curado.

INFESTATION.name: INFESTATION
INFESTATION.en: The foe is infested and attacked for four to five turns. It cannot flee during that time.
INFESTATION.pt: Infesta o alvo e o ataca por quatro a cinco turnos. Ele não pode fugir nesse tempo.

METEOR_BEAM.name: METEOR BEAM
METEOR_BEAM.en: The user gathers space power, raising its SP. ATK on the first turn, then attacks on the next.
METEOR_BEAM.pt: Reúne poder espacial e aumenta o ATQ. ESP. no primeiro turno; ataca no seguinte.

FELL_STINGER.name: FELL STINGER
FELL_STINGER.en: When the user knocks out a foe with this move, its ATTACK rises drastically.
FELL_STINGER.pt: Se nocautear o alvo com este golpe, o ATAQUE do usuário aumenta drasticamente.

STEEL_BEAM.name: STEEL BEAM
STEEL_BEAM.en: The user fires a beam of steel. The user loses half of its max HP even if it misses.
STEEL_BEAM.pt: Dispara um raio de aço. O usuário perde metade do HP máximo mesmo se errar.

FINAL_GAMBIT.name: FINAL GAMBIT
FINAL_GAMBIT.en: The user risks everything to attack. It deals damage equal to its HP, and then faints.
FINAL_GAMBIT.pt: Arrisca tudo: causa dano igual ao próprio HP e depois desmaia.

METAL_BURST.name: METAL BURST
METAL_BURST.en: The user retaliates against the last foe to hit it this turn with much greater force.
METAL_BURST.pt: Revida contra o último a atingi-lo neste turno com força muito maior.

COMEUPPANCE.name: COMEUPPANCE
COMEUPPANCE.en: The user retaliates against the last foe to hit it this turn with much greater force.
COMEUPPANCE.pt: Revida contra o último a atingi-lo neste turno com força muito maior.

TRIPLE_AXEL.name: TRIPLE AXEL
TRIPLE_AXEL.en: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
TRIPLE_AXEL.pt: Três chutes seguidos que ficam mais fortes a cada acerto.

AXE_KICK.name: AXE KICK
AXE_KICK.en: The user kicks up and drops its heel. It may confuse the foe. If it misses, the user is hurt.
AXE_KICK.pt: Ergue a perna e desce o calcanhar. Pode confundir. Se errar, o usuário se fere.

SUPERCELL_SLAM.name: SUPERCELLSLM
SUPERCELL_SLAM.en: The user electrifies itself and drops onto the foe. If it misses, the user is hurt.
SUPERCELL_SLAM.pt: Eletrifica-se e despenca sobre o alvo. Se errar, o usuário se fere.

POWER_TRICK.name: POWER TRICK
POWER_TRICK.en: The user employs its psychic power to switch its ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
POWER_TRICK.pt: Usa poder psíquico para trocar seu ATAQUE e sua DEFESA.

POWER_SWAP.name: POWER SWAP
POWER_SWAP.en: The user swaps all changes to its ATTACK and SP. ATK with the foe.
POWER_SWAP.pt: Troca com o alvo as mudanças de ATAQUE e ATQ. ESP.

GUARD_SWAP.name: GUARD SWAP
GUARD_SWAP.en: The user swaps all changes to its DEFENSE and SP. DEF with the foe.
GUARD_SWAP.pt: Troca com o alvo as mudanças de DEFESA e DEF. ESP.

POWER_SPLIT.name: POWER SPLIT
POWER_SPLIT.en: The user averages its ATTACK and SP. ATK with those of the foe.
POWER_SPLIT.pt: Tira a média do ATAQUE e do ATQ. ESP. com os do alvo.

GUARD_SPLIT.name: GUARD SPLIT
GUARD_SPLIT.en: The user averages its DEFENSE and SP. DEF with those of the foe.
GUARD_SPLIT.pt: Tira a média da DEFESA e da DEF. ESP. com as do alvo.

SOAK.name: SOAK
SOAK.en: The user shoots a torrent of water at the foe and changes its type to WATER.
SOAK.pt: Lança um jato de água no alvo e muda seu tipo para WATER.

REFLECT_TYPE.name: REFLECT TYPE
REFLECT_TYPE.en: The user reflects the foe's type, making it the same type as the foe.
REFLECT_TYPE.pt: Reflete o tipo do alvo e passa a ter o mesmo tipo.

WORRY_SEED.name: WORRY SEED
WORRY_SEED.en: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It changes the foe's ability to INSOMNIA.
WORRY_SEED.pt: Planta uma semente da preocupação. A habilidade do alvo vira INSOMNIA.

ENTRAINMENT.name: ENTRAINMENT
ENTRAINMENT.en: The user dances with an odd rhythm, making the foe's ability the same as its own.
ENTRAINMENT.pt: Dança num ritmo estranho que o alvo imita, copiando a habilidade do usuário.

GASTRO_ACID.name: GASTRO ACID
GASTRO_ACID.en: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of its ability.
GASTRO_ACID.pt: Lança ácido gástrico no alvo e anula o efeito de sua habilidade.

PSYCHO_SHIFT.name: PSYCHO SHIFT
PSYCHO_SHIFT.en: Using its psychic power, the user transfers its status condition to the foe.
PSYCHO_SHIFT.pt: Com poder psíquico, transfere seu problema de status para o alvo.

ACUPRESSURE.name: ACUPRESSURE
ACUPRESSURE.en: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats at random.
ACUPRESSURE.pt: Pressiona pontos de tensão e aumenta muito um atributo aleatório.

ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.name: ELECTRC TERR
ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.en: Electrifies the ground for five turns: no sleep when grounded, stronger ELECTRIC moves.
ELECTRIC_TERRAIN.pt: Eletrifica o chão por cinco turnos: ninguém no chão dorme e ELECTRIC fica mais forte.

GRASSY_TERRAIN.name: GRASSY TERR.
GRASSY_TERRAIN.en: Grass covers the ground for five turns, healing grounded POKéMON and powering GRASS moves.
GRASSY_TERRAIN.pt: A grama cobre o chão por cinco turnos, cura quem está no chão e fortalece golpes GRASS.

MISTY_TERRAIN.name: MISTY TERR.
MISTY_TERRAIN.en: Mist covers the ground for five turns: no status when grounded, weaker DRAGON moves.
MISTY_TERRAIN.pt: Névoa no chão por cinco turnos: bloqueia status e enfraquece golpes DRAGON.

PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.name: PSYCHC TERR.
PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.en: Makes the ground weird for five turns. It blocks foes' priority moves and powers PSYCHIC moves.
PSYCHIC_TERRAIN.pt: Chão estranho por cinco turnos: bloqueia prioridade rival e fortalece PSYCHIC.

TRICK_ROOM.name: TRICK ROOM
TRICK_ROOM.en: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower POKéMON get to move first for five turns.
TRICK_ROOM.pt: Cria uma área bizarra onde os mais lentos agem primeiro por cinco turnos.

TAILWIND.name: TAILWIND
TAILWIND.en: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the SPEED of its team for four turns.
TAILWIND.pt: Cria um vento turbulento que dobra a VELOCIDADE da equipe por quatro turnos.

GRAVITY.name: GRAVITY
GRAVITY.en: Gravity intensifies for five turns, grounding everyone and making moves more accurate.
GRAVITY.pt: A gravidade aumenta por cinco turnos, prende todos ao chão e aumenta a precisão.

MAGIC_ROOM.name: MAGIC ROOM
MAGIC_ROOM.en: The user creates a bizarre area in which held items lose their effects for five turns.
MAGIC_ROOM.pt: Cria uma área bizarra onde os itens segurados perdem o efeito por cinco turnos.

WONDER_ROOM.name: WONDER ROOM
WONDER_ROOM.en: The user creates a bizarre area in which DEFENSE and SP. DEF stats are swapped for five turns.
WONDER_ROOM.pt: Cria uma área bizarra onde DEFESA e DEF. ESP. trocam de lugar por cinco turnos.

SNOWSCAPE.name: SNOWSCAPE
SNOWSCAPE.en: The user summons a snowstorm for five turns. It raises the DEFENSE of ICE types.
SNOWSCAPE.pt: Invoca uma nevasca por cinco turnos. Aumenta a DEFESA do tipo ICE.

GRASSY_GLIDE.name: GRASSY GLIDE
GRASSY_GLIDE.en: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks. It always strikes first on GRASSY TERRAIN.
GRASSY_GLIDE.pt: Desliza pelo chão e ataca. Sempre age primeiro no GRASSY TERRAIN.

EXPANDING_FORCE.name: EXPAND FORCE
EXPANDING_FORCE.en: The user attacks with psychic power. It is stronger on PSYCHIC TERRAIN.
EXPANDING_FORCE.pt: Ataca com poder psíquico. É mais forte no PSYCHIC TERRAIN.

MISTY_EXPLOSION.name: MISTY EXPLSN
MISTY_EXPLOSION.en: The user attacks everything around it and faints. It is stronger on MISTY TERRAIN.
MISTY_EXPLOSION.pt: Ataca todos ao redor e desmaia. É mais forte no MISTY TERRAIN.

STEALTH_ROCK.name: STEALTH ROCK
STEALTH_ROCK.en: Floating stones surround the foes, hurting each foe that switches in; more if weak to ROCK.
STEALTH_ROCK.pt: Pedras flutuantes cercam os rivais e ferem quem entrar; mais se for fraco a ROCK.

TOXIC_SPIKES.name: TOXIC SPIKES
TOXIC_SPIKES.en: Poison spikes are scattered at the foes' feet. Grounded foes that switch in get poisoned.
TOXIC_SPIKES.pt: Espinhos venenosos são espalhados. Rivais no chão que entrarem são envenenados.

STICKY_WEB.name: STICKY WEB
STICKY_WEB.en: A sticky net is woven around the foes. It lowers the SPEED of grounded foes that switch in.
STICKY_WEB.pt: Tece uma rede pegajosa em volta dos rivais. Reduz a VELOCIDADE de quem entrar no chão.

DEFOG.name: DEFOG
DEFOG.en: A strong wind lowers the foe's evasion and blows away hazards, screens and terrain.
DEFOG.pt: Um vento forte reduz a evasão do alvo e varre obstáculos, telas e terreno.

QUICK_GUARD.name: QUICK GUARD
QUICK_GUARD.en: Protects the user's team from priority moves for one turn.
QUICK_GUARD.pt: Protege a equipe de golpes com prioridade por um turno.

WIDE_GUARD.name: WIDE GUARD
WIDE_GUARD.en: Protects the user's team from moves that hit more than one target this turn.
WIDE_GUARD.pt: Protege a equipe de golpes que atingem mais de um alvo neste turno.

SPIKY_SHIELD.name: SPIKY SHIELD
SPIKY_SHIELD.en: Protects the user from attacks. Foes that make contact are hurt by the spikes.
SPIKY_SHIELD.pt: Protege o usuário de ataques. Quem fizer contato se fere nos espinhos.

AFTER_YOU.name: AFTER YOU
AFTER_YOU.en: The user helps the target move right after it, ahead of everyone else.
AFTER_YOU.pt: O usuário ajuda o alvo a agir logo depois dele, antes dos demais.

QUASH.name: QUASH
QUASH.en: The user suppresses the target, making it move last in the turn.
QUASH.pt: O usuário reprime o alvo, que passa a agir por último no turno.

ROOST.name: ROOST
ROOST.en: The user lands and rests, restoring half its max HP. It loses its FLYING type this turn.
ROOST.pt: Pousa e descansa, recuperando metade do HP. Perde o tipo FLYING neste turno.

AQUA_RING.name: AQUA RING
AQUA_RING.en: A veil of water surrounds the user, restoring a little HP every turn.
AQUA_RING.pt: Um véu de água envolve o usuário e restaura um pouco de HP a cada turno.

MAGNET_RISE.name: MAGNET RISE
MAGNET_RISE.en: The user levitates with electromagnetism, avoiding GROUND moves for five turns.
MAGNET_RISE.pt: Levita com eletromagnetismo e evita golpes GROUND por cinco turnos.

LASER_FOCUS.name: LASER FOCUS
LASER_FOCUS.en: The user focuses intensely. Its attack on the next turn is a critical hit.
LASER_FOCUS.pt: Concentra-se intensamente. O ataque do próximo turno é um golpe crítico.

THROAT_CHOP.name: THROAT CHOP
THROAT_CHOP.en: A chop to the throat. The target can't use sound-based moves for two turns.
THROAT_CHOP.pt: Um golpe na garganta. O alvo não usa golpes sonoros por dois turnos.

SMACK_DOWN.name: SMACK DOWN
SMACK_DOWN.en: A thrown stone knocks a flying target to the ground, where GROUND moves hit it.
SMACK_DOWN.pt: Uma pedra derruba o alvo que voa, e golpes GROUND passam a atingi-lo.

PSYCHIC_NOISE.name: PSYCHICNOISE
PSYCHIC_NOISE.en: Unpleasant sound waves that keep the target from healing for two turns.
PSYCHIC_NOISE.pt: Ondas sonoras desagradáveis impedem o alvo de se curar por dois turnos.

HEALING_WISH.name: HEALING WISH
HEALING_WISH.en: The user faints. The POKéMON that replaces it is fully healed.
HEALING_WISH.pt: O usuário desmaia. O POKéMON que entrar no lugar é curado por completo.

PHANTOM_FORCE.name: PHANTOMFORCE
PHANTOM_FORCE.en: The user vanishes, then strikes on the next turn. It hits even through PROTECT.
PHANTOM_FORCE.pt: Some e ataca no turno seguinte. Acerta mesmo quem usa PROTECT.

STOMPING_TANTRUM.name: STOMPTANTRUM
STOMPING_TANTRUM.en: Driven by frustration, it attacks. Power doubles if the user's last move failed.
STOMPING_TANTRUM.pt: Ataca frustrado. O poder dobra se o último golpe do usuário falhou.

TEMPER_FLARE.name: TEMPER FLARE
TEMPER_FLARE.en: A desperate fiery attack. Power doubles if the user's last move failed.
TEMPER_FLARE.pt: Ataque desesperado em chamas. O poder dobra se o último golpe falhou.

LASH_OUT.name: LASH OUT
LASH_OUT.en: The user lashes out in anger. Power doubles if its stats were lowered this turn.
LASH_OUT.pt: Ataca com raiva. O poder dobra se os atributos do usuário caíram neste turno.

BURNING_JEALOUSY.name: BURNJEALOUSY
BURNING_JEALOUSY.en: Jealous flames hit the foes. Foes whose stats rose this turn are burned.
BURNING_JEALOUSY.pt: Chamas de inveja atingem os rivais. Quem subiu atributos no turno é queimado.

ALLURING_VOICE.name: ALLURE VOICE
ALLURING_VOICE.en: An angelic voice attack. It confuses a target whose stats rose this turn.
ALLURING_VOICE.pt: Voz angelical. Confunde o alvo se seus atributos subiram neste turno.

RETALIATE.name: RETALIATE
RETALIATE.en: The user avenges a fallen ally. Power doubles if an ally fainted last turn.
RETALIATE.pt: Vinga um aliado caído. O poder dobra se um aliado desmaiou no último turno.

ECHOED_VOICE.name: ECHOED VOICE
ECHOED_VOICE.en: An echoing voice. Power rises each turn the move is used in a row.
ECHOED_VOICE.pt: Uma voz que ecoa. O poder sobe a cada turno seguido em que é usada.

ROUND.name: ROUND
ROUND.en: A song attack. Power doubles if an ally already used ROUND this turn.
ROUND.pt: Ataque com canto. O poder dobra se um aliado já usou ROUND neste turno.

RAGE_FIST.name: RAGE FIST
RAGE_FIST.en: A punch fueled by rage. Power rises each time the user has been hit.
RAGE_FIST.pt: Soco movido pela raiva. O poder sobe cada vez que o usuário foi atingido.

LAST_RESORT.name: LAST RESORT
LAST_RESORT.en: A last-resort attack. It works only after the user has used all its other moves.
LAST_RESORT.pt: Último recurso. Só funciona depois de usar todos os outros golpes.

BELCH.name: BELCH
BELCH.en: The user belches at the target. It can be used only after eating a BERRY.
BELCH.pt: Arroto no alvo. Só pode ser usado depois de comer uma BERRY.

COPYCAT.name: COPYCAT
COPYCAT.en: The user copies the move used right before it in the battle.
COPYCAT.pt: O usuário copia o golpe usado logo antes dele na batalha.

SCALE_SHOT.name: SCALE SHOT
SCALE_SHOT.en: Shoots scales 2 to 5 times. Then raises SPEED but lowers DEFENSE.
SCALE_SHOT.pt: Dispara escamas de 2 a 5 vezes. Depois sobe a VELOCIDADE e reduz a DEFESA.

INCINERATE.name: INCINERATE
INCINERATE.en: Flames hit the foes. Any BERRY a foe holds is burnt up and lost.
INCINERATE.pt: Chamas atingem os rivais e queimam a BERRY que estiverem segurando.

BUG_BITE.name: BUG BITE
BUG_BITE.en: The user bites the target. If it holds a BERRY, the user eats it and gets its effect.
BUG_BITE.pt: Morde o alvo. Se ele segura uma BERRY, o usuário a come e ganha o efeito.

PLUCK.name: PLUCK
PLUCK.en: The user pecks the target. If it holds a BERRY, the user eats it and gets its effect.
PLUCK.pt: Bica o alvo. Se ele segura uma BERRY, o usuário a come e ganha o efeito.

POLTERGEIST.name: POLTERGEIST
POLTERGEIST.en: The target is attacked by its own held item. It fails if the target holds no item.
POLTERGEIST.pt: O alvo é atacado pelo próprio item. Falha se ele não segura nenhum item.

COACHING.name: COACHING
COACHING.en: The user coaches its allies, raising their ATTACK and DEFENSE.
COACHING.pt: O usuário treina os aliados, aumentando o ATAQUE e a DEFESA deles.

MAGNETIC_FLUX.name: MAGNETICFLUX
MAGNETIC_FLUX.en: Raises DEFENSE and SP. DEF of the user and allies with PLUS or MINUS.
MAGNETIC_FLUX.pt: Aumenta DEFESA e DEF. ESP. do usuário e aliados com PLUS ou MINUS.

DRAGON_CHEER.name: DRAGON CHEER
DRAGON_CHEER.en: Cheers on allies, raising their critical-hit ratio. DRAGON types get a bigger boost.
DRAGON_CHEER.pt: Anima os aliados e aumenta a chance de crítico. Tipos DRAGON ganham mais.

AUTOTOMIZE.name: AUTOTOMIZE
AUTOTOMIZE.en: The user sheds part of its body, sharply raising SPEED and getting lighter.
AUTOTOMIZE.pt: Solta partes do corpo, aumentando muito a VELOCIDADE e ficando mais leve.

SIMPLE_BEAM.name: SIMPLE BEAM
SIMPLE_BEAM.en: A mysterious beam that changes the target's ability to SIMPLE.
SIMPLE_BEAM.pt: Um raio misterioso que muda a habilidade do alvo para SIMPLE.

FIRE_PLEDGE.name: FIRE PLEDGE
FIRE_PLEDGE.en: A column of fire hits the target.
FIRE_PLEDGE.pt: Uma coluna de fogo atinge o alvo.

WATER_PLEDGE.name: WATER PLEDGE
WATER_PLEDGE.en: A column of water hits the target.
WATER_PLEDGE.pt: Uma coluna de água atinge o alvo.

GRASS_PLEDGE.name: GRASS PLEDGE
GRASS_PLEDGE.en: A column of grass hits the target.
GRASS_PLEDGE.pt: Uma coluna de plantas atinge o alvo.
